name: Windows utilities · Info+ CLI
description: PowerShell workstation diagnostics CLI for refurb and QA: modular scripts merged into one bundle and compiled to a Windows executable with PS2EXE.
longDescription: Info+ is a PowerShell-first Windows utility built for desktop refurbishment and field diagnostics. Dozens of focused .ps1 modules: system inventory, hardware tests, tweaks, and maintenance: are merged into a single script bundle, then compiled to infoplus.exe with PS2EXE, embedded version metadata, icon resources, and elevated-admin execution. Operators get an interactive console menu covering CPU, GPU, RAM, Windows activation and product keys, driver links, battery/camera/audio/screen checks, power and BitLocker tweaks, cache cleanup, and Windows Memory Diagnostic launch.
features: Modular PowerShell scripts merged into one distributable bundle
Interactive CLI menus for system info, hardware tests, and maintenance
CPU, GPU, RAM, Windows version, activation, and product-key reporting
Driver links plus battery, camera, audio, and screen pixel diagnostics
System tweaks including power settings, activation helpers, and BitLocker unlock
PS2EXE build pipeline with version metadata, icon, and require-admin flags
Syntax validation on the merged script before packaging
highlights: PowerShell-native tooling tailored to Windows workstation QA workflows
Single merged bundle reduces on-site deployment friction for technicians
Packaged Windows executable with traceable version resources
challenges: Field technicians need one portable tool that covers inventory, tests, and tweaks without juggling many separate scripts.
solutions: Modular PowerShell design with a merge-and-compile pipeline, shared helpers, and a menu-driven CLI that keeps refurb workflows repeatable.
security: Requires administrative privileges for hardware and system operations
Sign compiled executables when distributing outside trusted networks
Review merged script output before packaging; never embed secrets in builds
